observations: Photo 0: white compact projector body, large single lens near front, control buttons on top-front face, a watermark 'EMMATECH PROJECTORS POSTED ON JIJI' overlays the image.
Photo 0: 'EPSON' logo printed on top of the unit, clearly legible.
Photo 0: a small model/serial sticker area at bottom-right is visible but the text appears mirrored/flipped and is not legible as a clear alphanumeric string.
Photo 1: side/front view confirms the same white Epson-branded unit, 'EPSON' text legible on the body, no cables, remote, or power cord visible.
Photo 2: underside/rear view showing compartment covers, screws, and a rating label area, but the label text is too small/blurry to read any model number.
No photos show the unit powered on, projecting an image, or displaying any on-screen menu.
No remote control, HDMI cable, or power cable is shown in any photo.

claims.claim: Ultra-short-throw design allows presenting large images from a very short distance
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a bulky low-profile body consistent with UST projector shape, but no projection test or throw-distance demonstration is shown.
No power-on, lamp, or projected-image photo/video provided.

risks.risk: Exact model number unreadable (text on casing appears mirrored/blurred), and projector value varies greatly by model/brightness/resolution.
risks.proof: A clear, non-mirrored close-up photo of the model/serial label (usually on the bottom or side panel).
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at any tier; proof required before pricing

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have lamp/bulb failure, common in used projectors.
risks.proof: A video of the unit powering on and projecting an image or menu screen.

risks.risk: Lamp hours could be very high, reducing remaining useful life.
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of the lamp-hours counter from the projector's internal menu.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (remote, power cable, HDMI cable) not shown, which could add cost to make usable.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracked lens, dents, broken ports) not visible due to limited angles and watermark overlay obscuring detail.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens, all ports, and any corners/edges.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial sticker (bottom or rear panel), unmirrored and in focus.
Video of the projector powering on and displaying an image or its own menu screen.
Photo of the lamp-hours counter from the service/info menu.
Photo showing all accessories included (remote, cables).
Close-up photos of the lens and all connection ports for damage check.
response.reason: The brand Epson is legible, but the model number that determines the projector's tier and price is not readable in any photo, and no functional test is shown, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a clear model/serial shot.
